parameters.content:
## Error handler, lite (Slack only)
Set this workflow as the **Error workflow** of every unattended workflow (its Settings > Error workflow). Each failure is posted to one Slack channel once, then not again for 1 hour (P1) or 6 hours (P2).

**Setup:** on **Slack Alert**, set Authentication to match your Slack credential (OAuth2, or Access Token for a bot token) and pick it, replace `{SLACK_CHANNEL_ID}`, save, then **Publish**. n8n runs only the published version of an error workflow; publish again after every edit.

**Tiers:** P1 = credential or auth failure. P2 = any other failure. P3 = workflows named TEST, TEMP or DEMO: not posted. Edit the two settings at the top of Classify to change that.

**Callers:** keep this workflow in the same project as the workflows it watches, or allow them under its Settings > This workflow can be called by. Any other caller is blocked.

**If Slack is down** the alert is lost; it appears only in this workflow's execution list.

**No database:** the repeat check uses this workflow's own stored data. It is kept only for published runs, which is how error workflows run.

**Upgrade:** workflow.json in the same repository adds a Notion log, email for P1, and an email fallback when Slack is down.

nodes.name: Classify
nodes.notes: Tier, masking and the repeat check. Returns nothing (so nothing is posted) for P3 and for a repeat inside the window.

nodes.name: Slack Alert
nodes.notes: Pick the Slack credential here. The Slack app must be a member of the channel (private channels need an explicit invite).

nodes.name: Remember
nodes.notes: Records the posted failure for the repeat check. Runs only when Slack succeeded.
